shortcut_help_description: Available shortcuts change with the current view and focus.
navigation_description: Open a destination without leaving the current workspace.
workspace_empty_description: Charon keeps notes in a local folder you control.
workspace_choose_disabled: Folder selection arrives with onboarding in Plan 008.
workspace_error_description: Charon stopped before changing files. Reopen the workspace or use recovery.
workspace_warning: Showing the last valid workspace while a recoverable issue needs attention.
notes_empty: This workspace has no visible notes yet.
note_empty_workspace_description: Start with a local Markdown fragment in the current section.
note_empty_section_description: Choose another section or create a note here.
note_empty_search_description: Try fewer words or clear the status filter.
note_editor_description: Plain Markdown is saved locally after a short pause or when focus leaves the editor.
note_editor_save_error: The note was not saved. Your draft is preserved; retry after resolving the workspace issue.
note_editor_discard_description: Only changes in this open editor will be reverted.
copy_preview_description: This exact Markdown will be written only when you choose Copy.
clipboard_error_empty_selection: Select at least one note before copying.
clipboard_error_all_bodies_empty: Every selected note is empty, so nothing was written.
clipboard_error_invalid_request: The selection changed before copy. Review it and retry.
clipboard_error_permission_denied: Clipboard write access was denied. Allow it in system settings, then retry.
clipboard_error_platform_unavailable: Clipboard writing is unavailable on this platform. Your selection is preserved.
clipboard_error_write_failed: The clipboard could not be written. Your selection is preserved; retry.
clipboard_error_workspace_unavailable: The current workspace could not be verified. Reopen it, then retry.
merge_description: Review the exact composite before the sources move to recoverable trash.
merge_error: The composite was not created and the source notes were not changed. Review the workspace issue and retry.
trash_confirm_one: This note from {context} will remain recoverable.
trash_confirm_many: These {count} notes from {context} will move in one recoverable transaction.
trash_confirm_error: No note moved to trash. Review the workspace issue and retry.
trash_restore_error: The notes were not restored. Review the workspace issue and retry.
trash_permanent_single_only: Select exactly one trashed note for permanent deletion.
trash_permanent_description: This removes the Markdown file and cannot be undone.
trash_permanent_error: The note was not permanently deleted. Review the workspace issue and retry.
undo_status_description: The whole selection can be restored to its previous status.
undo_move_description: The whole move can be undone.
undo_restore_description: The restore transaction can be undone.
undo_merge_description: Undo restores every source and removes the composite.
section_manage_description: Create, rename, reorder, or remove empty sections.
section_delete_blocked: Move every note out of this section before deleting it.
command_notes_search_description: Move focus to the note search field.
command_notes_new_description: Create a note in the current section.
command_notes_edit_description: Open the active note in the Markdown editor.
command_notes_save_description: Save the current Markdown draft without closing the editor.
command_notes_toggle_status_description: Mark the active selection open or done.
command_copy_default_description: Copy the ordered selection with the default Markdown format.
command_copy_preview_description: Preview the ordered selection with the default copy format.
command_copy_preset_description: Copy the ordered selection with this Markdown format.
command_selection_all_description: Select only notes in the current visible result set.
command_selection_extend_up_description: Add the previous visible note to the ordered selection.
command_selection_extend_down_descriptio: Add the next visible note to the ordered selection.
command_notes_reorder_up_description: Move the active note earlier in its section.
command_notes_reorder_down_description: Move the active note later in its section.
command_notes_trash_description: Move the active selection to recoverable trash.
command_notes_move_description: Choose a destination section for the active selection.
command_notes_merge_description: Review and create a composite from two or more notes.
command_workspace_undo_description: Apply the inverse of the latest recoverable transaction.
workspace_error_stale_revision: The workspace changed outside this view. The latest version is loaded; review it and retry.
workspace_error_invalid_path: The selected path is outside the workspace or is not a supported local path.
workspace_error_invalid_manifest: The workspace manifest is invalid. Charon kept the last valid state and did not write changes.
workspace_error_unsupported_schema: This workspace was created by an unsupported schema version. Open it with a compatible Charon version.
workspace_error_validation: The requested change violates a workspace rule. Review the note and section state, then retry.
workspace_error_io: The local files could not be read or written. Check folder access and available disk space, then retry.
workspace_error_recovery_required: An interrupted workspace transaction requires local recovery before more changes can be saved.
workspace_error_not_found: A note or section used by this action no longer exists. The latest workspace state is displayed.
workspace_error_runtime_lock: The local workspace is temporarily busy. No files were changed; retry in a moment.
settings_description: Theme and language apply immediately. More settings arrive with onboarding.
settings_placeholder: Workspace settings are not enabled in this plan.
stats_disabled_description: Local charts remain optional and will be added behind a feature flag.
route_error: This view could not be opened. Your workspace was not changed.
capture_description: Capture Markdown locally without leaving your current task.
capture_markdown_placeholder: Write a thought, prompt fragment, or next step…
capture_section_empty_error: Create or restore a section in the main window before saving this draft.
capture_workspace_empty: Open a local workspace in the main window before saving. Your draft is preserved.
capture_save_error: The note was not saved. Your draft is preserved; review the workspace issue and retry.
capture_discard_description: This unsaved Markdown will be removed. Your workspace will not change.
capture_status_available: Double Shift and {shortcut} are available. Selected text is used only when authorized.
capture_status_native_only: Double Shift is available, but the standard global shortcut could not be registered. The visible capture command remains available.
capture_status_denied: Accessibility is off. Manual capture and {shortcut} still work with an empty draft.
capture_status_manual_only: Global capture is unavailable here. Use the visible capture command to open an empty draft.
capture_status_fallback: Enhanced capture is unsupported here. Use {shortcut} or the visible capture command.
capture_status_error: Enhanced capture is unavailable after an error. Use {shortcut} or the visible capture command.
command_capture_open_description: Open the local Markdown capture window with the standard fallback shortcut.
command_capture_double_shift: Open quick capture with double Shift
command_capture_double_shift_description: Use the consented native modifier sequence when the runtime reports it available.
capture_error_invalid_shortcut: That shortcut is not valid. The previous shortcut remains active.
capture_error_shortcut_registration: The shortcut is already used or could not be registered. The visible capture command still works.
capture_error_shortcut_unregistration: The previous shortcut could not be removed safely. Retry before changing it.
capture_error_listener_unavailable: The enhanced capture listener could not start. Use the standard shortcut.
capture_error_permission_denied: Accessibility permission is denied. Manual capture remains available.
capture_error_selection_unsupported: Selected-text capture is unsupported here. Enter Markdown manually.
capture_error_selection_failed: Selected text could not be read. Nothing was copied or replaced; enter Markdown manually.
capture_error_window_unavailable: The quick-capture window could not be controlled. Your unsaved draft remains visible.
capture_error_shutdown: Capture is shutting down. Reopen Charon to register the shortcut again.
capture_error_runtime_lock: Capture is temporarily busy. Retry in a moment.
capture_error_unknown: Quick capture encountered an unexpected local error. Your draft is preserved.
